name: AuctionCities.com, Inc.
summary: AuctionCities.com, Inc. functions as an e-commerce enterprise, primarily operating its signature online auction platform, auctioncities.com. This digital marketplace is engineered for automated transactions, facilitating direct connections between buyers and sellers. Beyond its core auction services, the company also provides an array of other online goods and functionalities. Users can auction, buy, and sell a wide variety of merchandise, including but not limited to books, apparel, collectibles, computing devices, electronic gadgets, floral arrangements, jewelry and precious stones, toys, office supplies, clearance items, health and beauty products, and even pets. Established in 1999 under its former name, USA Dial-Up, Inc., the corporation maintains its headquarters in Newport Beach, California.
